data.name: Jobs_EmptyHint
data.value: Select a job or add a new one.

data.name: Jobs_NoJobs
data.value: No backup jobs yet. Click "Add Job" to get started.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step1
data.value: Click "+ Add Job" to create a new backup job.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step2
data.value: Enter a job name, the source folder and the target folder.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step3
data.value: Choose "Full" (copies all files) or "Differential" (copies only changed files).

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step4
data.value: Click "Add Job" to save it to the list.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step5
data.value: Select a job and click "Run" to start the backup immediately.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step6
data.value: Use "Run All" to execute every job in sequence.

data.name: Help_Jobs_Step7
data.value: You can Pause, Resume or Stop a running job from the detail panel.

data.name: Help_Settings_LogFormat_Desc
data.value: JSON (default) or XML. Logs are stored in the application data folder.

data.name: Help_Settings_Language_Desc
data.value: English or French. A restart is required to apply language changes.

data.name: Help_Settings_Encrypted_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated list (e.g. .docx, .xlsx). Files with these extensions are encrypted via CryptoSoft before copying.

data.name: Help_Settings_Priority_Desc
data.value: Files with these extensions are transferred before others during a parallel backup run.

data.name: Help_Settings_Business_Desc
data.value: Process name (without .exe) of software that blocks backups when running (e.g. calc).

data.name: Help_Settings_LargeFile_Desc
data.value: Files larger than this threshold are transferred one at a time to avoid overloading the network.

data.name: Help_Settings_CryptoSoft_Desc
data.value: Full path to CryptoSoft.exe used for file encryption.

data.name: Help_Logs_Desc1
data.value: EasySave writes one log file per day in JSON or XML format.

data.name: Help_Logs_Desc2
data.value: Each log entry records: timestamp, job name, source path, target path, file size, and transfer duration.

data.name: Help_Logs_Desc3
data.value: A state file (state.json) is updated in real time during each backup run.

data.name: Help_Logs_Desc4
data.value: Click "Open logs folder" in Settings to open the logs directory in File Explorer.

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc1
data.value: EasySave can forward logs to a centralized HTTP log server running in Docker.

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc2
data.value: In Settings, set "Log storage mode" to "CentralOnly" or "LocalAndCentral".

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc3
data.value: Enter the log server URL (e.g. http://localhost:5275/logs) in "Central log server URL".

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc4
data.value: When you save with central logging enabled, EasySave automatically runs: docker compose up -d

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc5
data.value: The docker-compose.yml file must be present in or near the application directory.

data.name: Help_Docker_Desc6
data.value: Docker Desktop must be installed and running on your machine for this feature to work.

data.name: About_Project_Desc
data.value: EasySave is a backup application developed by ProSoft for the Software Engineering project (PGE A3 FISE INFO 2025-2026).

data.name: About_Project_Details
data.value: It provides a modern WPF interface for creating, configuring, and executing full or differential backup jobs with advanced features like parallel execution, priority file handling, bandwidth limitations, and centralized Docker logging.

data.name: About_Features_Backup
data.value: Full and differential backup modes with real-time progress tracking

data.name: About_Features_Parallel
data.value: Parallel job execution with thread-safe synchronization

data.name: About_Features_Priority
data.value: Priority file extension handling for critical data

data.name: About_Features_Bandwidth
data.value: Bandwidth limitation for large file transfers

data.name: About_Features_Docker
data.value: Centralized Docker-based log server with HTTP API

data.name: About_GetStarted_Step1
data.value: 1. Go to the Jobs tab and click "Add Job" to create a new backup task.

data.name: About_GetStarted_Step2
data.value: 2. Configure your source folder, destination, and backup type (Full or Differential).

data.name: About_GetStarted_Step3
data.value: 3. Click "Run" to start the backup. Monitor progress in the Jobs tab or view logs in the Logs tab.
